# Hikari no Matsuri 2027 (HNM Vol. 3) — Complete AI Reference

Website: https://hnm3.vercel.app/
Date: January 8, 2027 (09:00 AM – 08:30 PM IST)
Location: Chennai Institute of Technology (CIT), Sarathy Nagar, Kundrathur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600069, India
Organizers: Lumos (Student Community of CIT) in partnership with Isshoni Nihongo (Japanese Language and Culture Club)

---

## Festival Overview
Hikari no Matsuri (光の祭り), translating to "Festival of Lights", is Chennai's flagship celebration of Japanese culture, anime, manga, cosplay, and gaming. Following the diplomatic acclaim of HNM Vol. 2 (documented at https://hnmvol2.com/ with official Japanese delegates and consulates), Vol. 3 is organized under the theme "Kizuna" (絆 - Unbreakable Bonds).

The single-day cultural extravaganza combines authentic traditional Japanese arts (tea ceremonies, Bon Odori dancing, calligraphy, and yukata wearing) with modern otaku culture (cosplay championships, Anisong live concerts, voice acting competitions, anime quizzes, and gaming tournaments).

---

## Ticketing Details
All passes are single-day credentials valid on January 8, 2027.
- **Student Pass (₹99)**:
  - Valid student ID required at entry gate.
  - Access to all festival grounds, outdoor exhibits, cultural zones, and Bon Odori circle.
- **General Otaku Pass (₹150)**:
  - Open to public and college students.
  - Access to all festival zones, live Anisong stage viewing, esports arena, and custom festival wristband.
- **VIP Matsuri Pass (₹175)**:
  - Reserved front-row seating for the Cosplay Masquerade and live Anisong concert.
  - Express queue privileges at the Yatai food stalls and Maid Cafe.
  - Collectible metal VIP badge, personalized Shodo calligraphy souvenir, and official festival poster.

Payment is processed securely online via Razorpay (UPI, Credit/Debit Cards, Net Banking).

---

## Detailed Event Schedule (January 8, 2027)
1. **09:30 AM – 10:15 AM**: Grand Opening Ceremony
   - Stage: Main Amphitheatre
   - Details: Welcome address by CIT leadership, Lumos organizers, and distinguished Japanese diplomatic & corporate delegates. Kagami Biraki (sake barrel breaking) ceremony for prosperity.
2. **10:30 AM – 11:30 AM**: Notes of Nippon (Traditional Ensemble)
   - Stage: Acoustic Pavilion
   - Details: Mesmerizing live performances of traditional Koto, Shamisen, and Taiko drum rhythms by visiting cultural artists.
3. **11:30 AM – 01:00 PM**: Akihabara no Quest (Esports & Trivia)
   - Stage: Gaming Arena
   - Details: Multi-round anime trivia competition and fighting game showcases (Tekken 8, Street Fighter 6, Naruto x Boruto).
4. **01:00 PM – 02:30 PM**: Cultural Immersion & Workshops
   - Stage: Cultural Courtyard
   - Details: Shodo (Japanese brush calligraphy) guided by master calligraphers, Origami folding masterclasses, and Yukata dress trials.
5. **02:30 PM – 04:30 PM**: Cosplay Masquerade & Runway
   - Stage: Main Amphitheatre
   - Details: National cosplay runway with over 50 registered contestants. Judged on costume craft, prop construction, character embodiment, and stage performance. Prize pool: ₹50,000+.
6. **04:30 PM – 05:45 PM**: Voice Acting Showdown & Anime Quiz
   - Stage: Auditorium Stage
   - Details: Live Japanese dubbing competitions where attendees re-voice famous anime scenes live on the big screen.
7. **06:00 PM – 07:30 PM**: J-Rock & Anisong Live Concert
   - Stage: Main Amphitheatre
   - Details: Electrifying live performances of iconic anime themes from Naruto, Jujutsu Kaisen, Demon Slayer, Attack on Titan, and Bleach performed by The Tokyo Echoes and guest artists.
8. **07:30 PM – 08:30 PM**: Lantern Lighting Ceremony & Bon Odori
   - Stage: Festival Courtyard
   - Details: 1,000 illuminated Japanese paper lanterns, synchronized Bon Odori circle dancing led by club members, and grand festival send-off.

---

## Special Guests
- **Kenji Takahashi**: Master calligrapher and traditional Shakuhachi flute artist based in Tokyo, conducting live Shodo demonstrations and masterclasses.
- **Aoi Sora Cosplay**: International award-winning cosplayer and prop maker; head judge for the HNM 2027 Cosplay Championship.
- **The Tokyo Echoes**: Acclaimed 5-piece J-Rock tribute band performing high-energy Anisong soundtracks and Japanese rock classics.

---

## Cosplay Guidelines
- All costumes must adhere to modesty and safety standards (no real steel weapons, functional firearms, or hazardous props).
- Dedicated changing rooms, lockers, and cosplay repair booths with glue guns, sewing kits, and safety pins are provided on campus free of charge.
- Registration for the competitive runway is open online and closes 1 hour before stage time on January 8.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- **Q: Who can attend Hikari no Matsuri 2027?**
  - A: Anyone! The festival is open to college students from all institutions, school students, anime fans, Japanese culture enthusiasts, and families.
- **Q: Do I need to know Japanese to attend?**
  - A: No! All announcements, signs, menus, and event hosting are conducted in English, with Japanese cultural phrases explained throughout.
- **Q: Can I buy tickets on-spot on January 8?**
  - A: A limited number of spot tickets will be available at CIT gates, but passes frequently sell out. Online pre-booking via https://hnm3.vercel.app/tickets is strongly recommended.
- **Q: How do I reach the venue?**
  - A: Chennai Institute of Technology is situated in Kundrathur, Chennai. Direct college shuttles operate from nearby metro stations (Alandur / Guindy) on festival day, and frequent MTC buses run to Kundrathur bus terminus.
- **Q: Is vegetarian food available?**
  - A: Yes! All food stalls in the Yatai Street clearly label vegetarian and non-vegetarian selections, including vegetarian Ramen, Yakisoba, Takoyaki alternatives, and Japanese desserts.

---

## Isshoni Nihongo Club
- **Affiliation**: Chennai Institute of Technology (CIT)
- **Mission**: Promoting Japanese language proficiency (JLPT N5 to N1), fostering bilateral India-Japan cultural appreciation, and connecting engineering students with higher education and career placements in Japan.
- **Activities**: Weekly language circles, anime review sessions, Japanese film screenings, kanji workshops, and cultural fests like Hikari no Matsuri.
- **Club Portal**: https://hnm3.vercel.app/club
